module: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne 9.2 Discrete Manufacturing & Shop Floor Management (JPD920 / PRODDTA)
description: Core tables, analytical views, and JDE Orchestrator v3 services for Discrete Manufacturing in Branch/Plant M30 (Central Discrete Mfg Plant). Note: JDE stores dates in 6-digit Julian format CYYDDD (use PRODDTA.JDE_TO_DATE(col) or query the pre-built PRODDTA.VW_JDE_MFG_* views) and scales quantities and unit costs by 10,000 (10^4) and total amounts by 100 (10^2).

tables.business_name: Shop-Floor Work Order Control Tower View
tables.description: Pre-scaled analytical view over F4801, F4101, and F0005 with human-readable dates, quantities, and schedule health flags.

columns.name: ASSEMBLY_ITEM
columns.description: 2nd Item Number (F4801.WALITM, e.g., AS-5000-SERVO, AS-6200-ROBOT, AS-7400-CTRL)

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Work Order Status Code (10=Entered, 30=Parts/Routing Attached, 40=Released, 45=Materials Issued, 50=In Queue, 90=Completed, 99=Closed)

tables.business_name: Work Order Parts List & Material Shortage View
tables.description: Compares F3111 Work Order Parts List requirements against F41021 Branch/Plant M30 net available inventory and F4311 open Purchase Orders.

columns.name: COMPONENT_ITEM
columns.description: Component Item Number (e.g., CM-1020-ENC, CM-1050-PCBA, CM-1060-BRG, SA-3100-GEAR)

columns.name: REQUIRED_QTY
columns.description: Total Required Quantity on Work Order

columns.name: EXPEDITE_PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Open Purchase Order Number in F4311 available to expedite (e.g., 430101, 430102, 430103)

columns.name: PO_PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Current Promised Delivery Date on Open PO

tables.business_name: Work Center Routing Load & Bottleneck View
tables.description: Aggregates F3112 Work Order Routing operations by Work Center (F0006).
Analyzes F3102 Production Costing Ledger across Cost Types A1 (Material), B1 (Direct Labor), B2 (Setup Labor), B3 (Machine Run), and C1 (Mfg Overhead).

columns.name: COST_TYPE
columns.description: Cost Component Code (A1, B1, B2, B3, C1)

columns.name: INPUT_VARIANCE_USD
columns.description: Actual minus Standard Cost Variance (Positive = Unfavorable Cost Overrun)

common_joins.description: Join Work Order Header (F4801) to Work Order Parts List (F3111)
Join Work Order Header (F4801) to Work Order Routing (F3112)
Join Work Order Header (F4801) to Production Costing (F3102)
Join Work Order Header (F4801) to Inventory Cardex Ledger (F4111)

example_queries.description: Get all LATE or AT_RISK_SHORTAGE Work Orders in Branch/Plant M30
example_queries.sql: SELECT * FROM PRODDTA.VW_JDE_MFG_WORK_ORDERS WHERE BRANCH_PLANT = 'M30' AND SCHEDULE_HEALTH IN ('LATE', 'AT_RISK_SHORTAGE') ORDER BY WORK_ORDER_NUMBER

example_queries.description: Get all component shortages and open expedite POs
example_queries.sql: SELECT * FROM PRODDTA.VW_JDE_MFG_PARTS_SHORTAGES WHERE SHORTAGE_QTY > 0 ORDER BY SHORTAGE_QTY DESC
